tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ོཾ༁hūm̐: snang srid zhi ba dkar po'i cho ga mi mthun zhi ba'i sman mchog bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ snang srid zhi ba dkar po ni: stegs bu gtsang zhing yid 'ong bar: zlum skor 'dab brgyad dbus su ā: kha khyer rdo rje dkar pos brgyan: de phyin gru bzhi phyogs mdog tshon: mu ran dmar po gru bzhi la: zla ba la gnas rdo rje phyed: dbus su bal bu shug pa dang: mkhan shug sur dkar la sogs pa'i: drag po min pa'i shing sna tshogs: phyur bur spungs la dud pa bya: yang na shug pa kho nas chog: gzhan yang shug pa'i byang bu ni: sor bcur sngags 'di bris pa bsham: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sogs gang 'dod sbyar la: shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: brgya'am stong sogs skabs dang bstun: mar gyi 'brang 'brang 'o zho mar: ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi dang: phye mar 'bru sna ja chang phud: dar sna stag gzig ras mo dang: rin chen mang po'i phye ma rnams: gzhi ma dkar gtsang steng du bsham: rang mdun mchog gsum zhi khro'i lha: skyabs gnas rnam pa thams cad bsam: sgo gsum gus pas 'di skad brjod: ho: phyogs dus bde gshegs byang chub sems: rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro la: bdag dang ma gyur 'gro kun gyis: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: dug lnga las byung gdug pa'i sems: rab zhi snying rje chen po yis: 'phags pa mchod dang rigs drug la: sbyin pa gtang phyir sems bskyed do: snang srid stong pa'i ngang las hrī: yongs gyur rang nyid thugs rje che: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis: mchod sbyin pad dkar 'dzin pa'i sku: zhi 'dzum dar dang rin chen brgyan: sems dpa'i skyil krung pad zlar bsam: spyi mgrin thugs ka'i 'bru gsum 'od: 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes sems: spyan drangs rang dang gnyis med thim: rigs lngas dbang bskur snang mtha' yis: dbur brgyan de la mchod pa'i tshogs: rab 'bul gus bstod nongs pa bshags: yo byad rnams la bsang chu gtor: oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ:

stong pa'i ngang las dngul snod yangs: rgya cher 'bru gsum 'od zhu las: zhi rdzas 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor ldan: kun bzang mchod sprin las lhag gyur: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bh+rūm̐ khaṃ swā hā: dkyil 'khor bsang chus bran byas nas: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs: stong gyur dngul lam dung las grub: zhi thab dkar zlum rgya khyon rdzogs: mtshan ldan rdo rje'i phreng bskor dbus: ra skyes steng du raṃ yig las: byung ba'i me lha dkar po ni: bgrang phreng spyi blugs thogs pas brgyan: dung ltar dkar ba'i cha lugs gsal: gnas gsum 'od kyis shar lho nas: me lha drang srong 'khor dang bcas: spyan drangs thab dbus pad nyi dang: ra skyes khrir bzhugs gnyis med thim: ag+ni rā dza sa mā dza: me dar g.yab cing 'di skad do: oṃ: 'byung ba me las byung ba'i lha: drang srong kun gyi ded dpon che: shar lho skyong ba'i 'jig rten mgon: 'dir gshegs dam ye dbyer med bzhugs: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.ag+ni rā dza tiṣ+ṭha lhan: oṃ: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: phyi nang gsang ba de kho na: mchod rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs 'bul: mi mthun zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ag+ne rā dza sa pa ri wā ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā: byang bu thogs la: oṃ: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: zhi shug byang bu'i 'dod gsol 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gdug sems zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: 'brang 'brang thogs la: oṃ: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: rin chen mar gyi 'brang 'brang 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gdug sems zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: 'o zho dkar gsum thogs la: oṃ: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: zho dang 'o ma dkar gsum 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gdug sems zhi bar mdzod:

oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: mngar gsum thogs la: oṃ: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gdug sems zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: phye mar thogs la: oṃ: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: phye mar ro mchog brgya ldan 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gdug sems zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: 'bru sna tshogs thogs la: oṃ: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: nas 'bras gro sogs 'bru sna 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gdug sems zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: ja chang thogs la: oṃ: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: ja dang chang dang phud skyems 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gdug sems zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ag+na ye swa hā: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: dar sna stag gzig ras mo thogs: oṃ: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: dar sna stag gzig ras mo 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gdug sems zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: rin chen sna tshogs thogs la: oṃ: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gdug sems zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: de rnams thab khung nang du 'bul: grangs ni brgya sogs skabs dang bstun: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: oṃ: tshangs dbang mgon sras drang srong rje: ag+ni rā dza cha lugs dkar: bgrang phreng spyi blugs thogs nas su: ra skyes zhon pa khyod la bstod: de nas mgron rigs bskyed pa ni: me lha'i lto bar rin chen sna tshogs khri:

yangs shing rgya cher seng chen pad zla'i steng: sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma'i dbus nas 'khrungs: gu ru shākya seng ge gser gyi mdog: rdo rje sa gnon mnyam gzhag lhung bzed bsnams: sprul sku'i cha lugs chos gos sham thabs mdzes: dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron gyis yongs bskor zhing: 'ja' 'od zer thag thig le'i klong du gsal: g.yas su 'jam dpal dmar ser ral gri 'dzin: sems dpa'i cha lugs dar dang rin chen spras: mgon po yon tan mgron gyis yongs bskor zhing: mchod rdzas sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i dbus su gsal: g.yon du dbang phyug dkar po phyag bzhi pa: thal sbyar phreng ba pad 'dzin longs sku'i chas: rigs drug snying rje'i mgron gyis yongs bskor zhing: thugs rje'i bsil zer 'phro ba'i dbus su gsal: rgyab tu gtum po mthing nag rdo rje 'dzin: khro gtum dpa' chas yongs rdzogs 'dor stabs bzhengs: bgegs rigs lan chags mgron gyis yongs bskor zhing: me dud zer gsum 'khrigs pa'i dbus su gsal: phyi skor gzhi bdag pho mo sprin ltar 'khrigs: cha lugs dkar po zhi ba'i sems dang ldan: skyabs mchog rnams la gus pa'i tshul gyis ni: phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs shing gnas par gyur: lha tshogs de dag gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas mchog dam pa nas: mgron rigs bzhi po char sprin rlung skyod ltar: skad cig spyan drangs so sor gnyis med thim: de nas rol mo dang bcas shing: me dar g.yab cing 'di skad do: oṃ: 'gro 'dul sprul sku'i zhing khams nas: gu ru shākya seng ge dang: mchog gsum la sogs sri zhu'i mgron: ma lus ji snyed gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas nas: 'jam dpal dang ni ye shes las: grub pa'i mgon po yon tan mgron: ma lus ji snyed gshegs su gsol: thugs rje chen po'i gzhal yas nas: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro ba drug: phyi rgyud 'jig rten snying rje'i mgron:

ma lus ji snyed gshegs su gsol: mthu stobs chen po'i pho brang nas: rdo rje 'dzin dang bgegs kyi rgyal: lan chags mgron du gyur pa rnams: skad cig nyid la gshegs su gsol: stong gsum stong chen yul ljongs nas: snang zhing srid pa'i gzhi bdag sogs: dad dang dam tshig dbang gis ni: zhi ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis med thim: pad zlar rang rang mdzes gdan la: gnyis med rang bzhin brtan par bzhugs: phyag 'tshal zhi mchod sna tshogs 'bul: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo zhi ba'i rdzas: shāka seng 'jam dpal thugs rje che: rdo rje gtum po'i lha tshogs mchod: dkar mngar 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron kun mchod: sman gtor rak+ta gsang mchod tshogs: mgon po yon tan mgron rnams mchod: zas gos mal cha yo byad dkor: rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams mchod: sha khrag lnga bcang glud rigs kyis: bgegs rigs lan chags mgron rnams mchod: dri gsur ja chang skyems phud kyis: stong gsum gzhi bdag ma lus mchod: mchod do 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes: mi mthun zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: oṃ: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thugs rje'i gar: pad+ma'i dbus 'khrungs sprul pa'i sku: snyigs ma'i 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa: shākya seng ge khyod la bstod: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku sprul las: mkhyen rab bdag po 'jam pa'i dbyangs: rmongs pa'i ma rig mun pa sel: gur gum mdog 'dzin khyod la bstod: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung sprul pa: thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs: rigs drug 'khor ba dong nas sprug: gangs ri'i mdog 'dzin khyod la bstod: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs sprul pa: mthu stobs mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin: log par 'dren pa mthar byed pa: nam mkha'i mdog 'dzin khyod la bstod: brtse gdung thugs rje rgyun chad med:

'gro ba mtha' dag 'dul mdzad pa: mchog gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: sri zhu'i mgron du gyur rnams bstod: bka' dang dam tshig srog ltar gces: sangs rgyas bstan pa thabs kyis srung: ye shes dang ni las las grub: yon tan mgron du gyur rnams bstod: rtogs na ma lus sangs rgyas nyid: ma rtogs rigs drug so sor snang: mthar thug sangs rgyas sa la 'god: snying rje'i mgron du gyur rnams bstod: drag shul ldan rnams kun tu rgyu: rang rigs rtogs na ye shes te: ma rtogs dug lnga bdag 'dzin pa: lan chags mgron du gyur rnams bstod: phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud lha: 'byung ba lnga la gnas bcas shing: rgyal ba'i bstan pa thabs kyis bsrung: 'jig rten mgron du gyur rnams bstod: de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni: thog mar shing byang thogs la: oṃ: dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams la: zhi shug byang bu'i 'dod gsol 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gnod sems zhi bar mdzod: na mo rat+na tra yā ya sa ma ya hūm̐: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ an+ta ra shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: 'brang 'brang thogs la: oṃ: dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams la: rin chen mar gyi 'brang 'brang 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gnod sems zhi bar mdzod: na mo rat+na tra yā ya sa ma ya hūm̐: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ an+ta ra shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: dkar gsum thogs la: oṃ: dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams la: zho dang 'o ma dkar gsum 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gnod sems zhi bar mdzod: na mo rat+na tra yā ya sa ma ya hūm̐: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ an+ta ra shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: mngar gsum thogs la: oṃ: dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams la: ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi 'bul: bzhes nas mi mthun nad rims bgegs: phrag dog gnod sems zhi bar mdzod: na mo rat+na tra yā ya sa ma ya hūm̐: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ an+ta ra shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā:

lha klu gnyan btsan sa bdag bdud: sman mo la sogs gzhi bdag dang: snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre'i tshogs: stong gsum la gnas thams cad kun: 'dir gshegs zhi rdzas sna tshogs dang: dri gsur bsang gi dud pa 'bul: bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: nad mug mtshon gsum zhi bar mdzod: yul khams bde zhing skyid gyur cig: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: ho: dgongs shig dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron: bslab gsum dor nas dug lnga spyod: mtshams med lnga po byas so cog: mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa stsol: ho: dgongs shig mgon po yon tan mgron: bskyed rdzogs don 'gal bskang mchod g.yel: ta na gha na tshad ma phyin: kha na ma tho bsgrubs so cog: mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa stsol: ho: dgongs shig rigs drug snying rje'i mgron: nga bdag khong khros gnod sems bsags: bsad gtubs brdungs brdegs rkus phrogs bcom: sdig pa'i rnam smin bsags so cog: mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa stsol: ho: dgongs shig bgegs rigs lan chags mgron: phan sems med par 'dre ngan brdungs: sngon gyi bu lon sha mkhon sgrib: rang sems 'dre ru bzung ngo cog: mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa stsol: ho: dgongs shig stong gsum gzhi bdag mgron: thab gzhob mkhon gsum mi rung spyod: sa chu shing rdo phru rlog bcad: thugs la ci 'gal byas so cog: mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa stsol: de nas phrin las bcol ba ni: kyai: mgron lnga mnyes shing tshims gyur nas: mi mthun zhi zhing 'byor drug rgyas: 'gro ba dbang sdud dgra bgegs brlag: ci bsam thogs med 'grub par mdzod: g.yang len ni: kyai: bla ma'i byin rlabs yi dam dngos grub dang: mkha' 'gro'i rten 'brel chos skyong drag rtsal stobs: nor lha'i dkor nor lha mi'i 'byor pa drug: yul lha'i bde skyid phywa dang g.yang du len: hu ye hu ldan phywa ye phywa brtan no: g.yang ri rab brtan g.yang gi ljon pa rgyas:
